title: Food Distribution for Poor & Needy
description: Providing essential food items to underprivileged families and individuals in need, ensuring no one goes hungry in our communities.
fullDescription: Our Food Distribution program is one of the core initiatives of Al-Khalid Trust, designed to address immediate hunger and food insecurity in vulnerable communities. We conduct regular food distribution drives every Monday and Thursday at noon, providing freshly prepared meals and essential food items to those in need. Each distribution session serves approximately 500 people, ensuring that individuals and families receive nutritious meals and basic food supplies including rice, flour, cooking oil, pulses, and other essential necessities.

Each session serves approximately 500 people
Freshly prepared meals and essential food items provided
Essential supplies including rice, flour, cooking oil, pulses, and basic necessities
Targeted distribution to underprivileged families and individuals
Community-based approach ensuring maximum reach and accessibility
Transparent distribution process with proper documentation and record-keeping

title: Monthly Grocery Support
description: Regular monthly grocery packages for struggling families, helping them meet their basic nutritional needs with dignity.
fullDescription: The Monthly Grocery Support program provides consistent financial assistance and comprehensive grocery packages to deserving families throughout the year. We have successfully supported more than 100 households with regular monthly grocery deliveries, ensuring they have access to all essential food items needed for complete nutrition. Each package is carefully curated to include rice, flour, cooking oil, pulses, spices, and other daily necessities, allowing families to maintain their dignity while meeting their nutritional requirements without financial burden.
details: Monthly grocery packages delivered to registered families
More than 100 households financially supported
Comprehensive food items for complete nutrition
Long-term consistent support for struggling families
Dignified distribution process maintaining respect and privacy
Regular monitoring and assessment of beneficiaries
Financial assistance for families unable to afford basic groceries

title: Small Business Setup for Poor & Widows
description: Empowering poor individuals and widows through small business setup programs, enabling them to earn a dignified livelihood.
fullDescription: Our Small Business Setup program focuses on empowering individuals, particularly widows and those from economically disadvantaged backgrounds, by providing them with the necessary resources, financial assistance, and support to establish their own small businesses. Through this initiative, we have successfully established more than 50 small businesses for needy individuals, creating sustainable income opportunities that enable beneficiaries to become self-reliant and financially independent. This program goes beyond immediate relief, fostering long-term economic empowerment and self-sufficiency.
details: More than 50 small businesses established for needy individuals
Financial assistance and grants for business setup
Training and mentorship programs for business development
Priority support for widows and single mothers
Small business loans with flexible repayment terms
Ongoing support and guidance for business growth and sustainability
Business planning and market analysis assistance

title: Water Bore Drilling in Water-Scarce Areas
description: Addressing water scarcity by arranging bore drilling in areas lacking access to clean water, ensuring communities have safe drinking water.
fullDescription: Access to clean water is a fundamental human right. Our Water Bore Drilling program addresses the critical issue of water scarcity in various communities across Pakistan. We have successfully completed more than 10 water bore drilling projects in areas where access to clean drinking water was limited or non-existent. These projects provide communities with a sustainable source of clean water, significantly improving their quality of life, health outcomes, and reducing the burden of water collection, especially for women and children.
details: More than 10 water bore drilling projects completed
Identification and assessment of water-scarce areas
Professional bore drilling services with quality assurance
Water quality testing and treatment facilities
Community water access points for easy distribution
Long-term maintenance and support for sustainability
Training community members on water management

title: Ramzan Rashan Package
description: Special Ramzan food packages containing essential items for families to observe the holy month with dignity and ease.
fullDescription: Each year during the holy month of Ramzan, Al-Khalid Trust organizes special Rashan (grocery) packages for families in need. These comprehensive packages contain all essential food items required for the entire month, including dates, rice, flour, cooking oil, pulses, sugar, tea, spices, and other daily necessities. We have successfully distributed these packages to more than 300 families annually, ensuring they can observe Ramzan with dignity and focus on their spiritual practices without worrying about their daily meals. The distribution takes place before Ramzan begins, allowing families to prepare adequately for the blessed month.

Targeted support for needy and deserving families

Community-wide impact ensuring no family goes hungry during Ramzan

title: Iftar Dinners During Ramzan
description: Organizing community iftar dinners throughout Ramzan, bringing together families and individuals to break their fast together.
fullDescription: Our Iftar Dinners program brings communities together during the blessed month of Ramzan. Each day throughout the holy month, we organize and distribute iftar dinners at our designated locations. People from all walks of life are welcome to come and break their fast with nutritious, balanced meals prepared with care. These daily community gatherings not only provide essential nutrition for those fasting but also foster a sense of unity, brotherhood, and shared spiritual experience among community members. The program creates an inclusive environment where everyone can participate in the blessings of Ramzan together.

Open to all community members to come and break their fast
Nutritious and balanced meals prepared daily
